dependencies.name: ufbx
dependencies.purpose: FBX and OBJ/MTL source ingestion, scene hierarchy and PBR material normalization
dependencies.security_boundary: source asset cooker only; source files are never parsed by the game executable

dependencies.name: cgltf
dependencies.purpose: glTF 2.0/GLB read-write bridge for Subspace-certified cooked assets
dependencies.security_boundary: runtime may parse only internally cooked GLBs whose hashes and certification records match the content catalog

dependencies.name: MikkTSpace
dependencies.purpose: canonical tangent generation for normal-mapped meshes

dependencies.name: glTF-Validator
dependencies.purpose: Khronos glTF 2.0 structural validation of every cooked GLB

bootstrap_rules: Never fetch dependencies during normal CMake configure/build.
Bootstrap downloads exact locked revisions into the project-local tool cache.
A bootstrap run records SHA-256 hashes for every acquired payload before installation.
Subsequent Full Gate runs are offline-capable and fail closed if cached bytes do not match the recorded lock hashes.
Runtime never opens FBX or OBJ source files.
Runtime GLB loading is restricted to generated assets with a matching catalog hash and successful Subspace certification record.
